Internal HR note, strictly confidential. This note contains personal data relating to Kestrel Haulage Ltd employees and must not be shared beyond authorised HR and operations management.

- Call-up notices received so far: 45 drivers. Individual names and personal details are held securely by HR and are not recorded here.
- Date by which these drivers must report for service: 01/12/2026. Please treat any related enquiries with discretion and direct them to HR in the first instance.
